Вивчимо назви тварин у зоопарку\nПрочита:
Learn the names of zoo animals
Read a short story about a day at the zoo
Learn to say what an animal can and can’t do: can / can’t
Describe your favourite animal
Почни з гри «Guess the animal»: покажи т: Start with the game «Guess the animal»: show an animal with movements and sounds (an elephant waving its trunk, a monkey scratching its head), and the child guesses in their own language or in English. Then ask 2-3 questions from the block. Don’t correct mistakes at this stage, the main thing is to get the child talking.
лев: a big wild cat with a mane
слон: a very big grey animal with a long trunk
мавпа: an animal that climbs trees and loves bananas
жирафа: an animal with a very long neck
зебра: a horse-like animal with black and white stripes
пінгвін: a black and white bird that swims but can’t fly
крокодил: a big reptile with a long mouth and sharp teeth
ведмідь: a big strong animal with thick fur
папуга: a colourful bird that can copy words
Промов кожне слово 2-3 рази, дитина повт: Say each word 2-3 times; the child repeats it and acts out the animal (TPR). Play «What’s missing?»: name 5 animals, «hide» one, and the child says which one is missing. Then do the exercises. After the exercises, add the words to the student’s dictionary.
Спочатку прочитай текст сам, дитина слух: First read the text yourself while the child listens and points to the animals in the pictures (you can draw them together). Then the child reads one sentence at a time. Gist: one question about the topic of the text. Detail: True / False and multiple choice. Correct pronunciation mistakes gently, just repeat the word correctly.
Read and choose True or False.
Щоб сказати, що тварина **вміє** робити,:
To say what an animal **is able** to do, use **can**: A monkey **can** climb. A penguin **can** swim.

If it **is not able** to, use **can’t**: A penguin **can’t** fly.

Question: **Can** a lion swim? Yes, it **can**. / No, it **can’t**.
Покажи правило на тілі: «I can jump» (ст: Show the rule with your body: «I can jump» (jump), «I can’t fly» (flap your arms and shake your head). The child repeats. Play «Yes or no?»: you say a sentence (A fish can run), and the child raises their hands if it’s true and sits down if it’s not. Then do the written exercises.
Гра «Who am I?»: дитина загадує тварину,: Play «Who am I?»: the child thinks of an animal, and you ask Can you fly? Can you swim? Are you big? The child answers Yes, I can / No, I can’t. Then swap roles. At the end, the child records a voice answer. Correct mistakes with can + verb (not can to swim).
Напиши про свою улюблену тварину (3 рече: Write about your favourite animal (3 sentences).
Exit task: дитина називає 5 тварин за 30: Exit task: the child names 5 animals in 30 seconds. Homework: draw «my zoo» with 4 animals and write a sentence with can / can’t for each one. You can also review the words in Murly games.
Вивчимо слова про розпорядок дня\nПослух:
Learn words about the daily routine
Listen to a dialogue between two children about their day
Learn to use the Present Simple: I get up, he gets up
Talk about your day
Гра «Mime my morning»: ти мовчки показує: Play «Mime my morning»: silently act out actions (waking up, brushing your teeth, having breakfast), and the child guesses. Guessing in their own language is fine, they will learn the words at the next stage. Review the time with the child: seven o’clock, eight o’clock.
вставати: to get out of bed in the morning
вмиватися: to clean your face with water
чистити зуби: to clean your teeth with a toothbrush
йти до школи: to travel to school for lessons
робити домашнє завдання: to do the school work you get for home
гратися: to have fun with toys or games
лягати спати: to go to sleep at night
година (рівно): used to say the exact hour, e.g. seven o’clock
Кожну фразу показуй рухом, дитина повтор: Show each phrase with a movement; the child repeats the word and the movement (TPR). Then play «Simon says»: Simon says brush your teeth! If the command doesn’t start with Simon says, nobody moves. After the game, do the exercises.
Перше слухання: дитина відповідає на заг: First listening: the child answers a general question (gist). Second listening: True / False. You can pause after each line. For movement: when the child hears an action (get up, play), they act it out.
Послухай. Про що говорять діти?: Listen. What are the children talking about?
**Present Simple** говорить про те, що м:
The **Present Simple** talks about things we do every day.

I get up, you get up, we get up, they get up.

But **he / she / it** + **-s**: he **gets** up, she **plays**.

Remember: go = he **goes**, do = she **does**, have = he **has**.
Дай дитині дві картки: «I» і «Tom». Ти к: Give the child two cards: «I» and «Tom». You say a verb (play), the child picks a card and says a sentence: I play. Tom plays. Pay special attention to goes, does, has. The most common mistake: She go. Correct it right away, but in a fun way: «Oops, Tom lost his -s!»
Він лягає спати о дев’ятій: He goes to bed at nine
Інтерв’ю: дитина питає тебе ті самі пита: Interview: the child asks you the same questions and then talks about you in the third person: My teacher gets up at 6. This practises the -s. You can draw clocks on paper and show the time. Then a voice answer.
Record a story about your morning.
Напиши про свій день (4-5 речень), як То: Write about your day (4-5 sentences), like Tom.
Exit task: дитина називає 3 речі, які во: Exit task: the child names 3 things they do every day and one thing mum or dad does (with -s). Homework: make a «My day» comic with 4-6 pictures and write a Present Simple sentence for each one.
Вивчимо назви їжі і напоїв\nПодивимось в:
Learn the names of food and drinks
Watch a fun song about strange dishes
Learn to ask Do you like…? and answer Yes, I do / No, I don’t
Make up your own crazy menu
Покажи два жести: «yummy» (гладимо живіт: Show two gestures: «yummy» (rub your tummy and smile) and «yucky» (make a face and wave your hand). Name dishes, and the child shows the gesture. Then ask 2-3 questions from the block.
броколі: a green vegetable that looks like a little tree
піца: a flat round bread with cheese and tomato on top
суп: a hot liquid food you eat with a spoon
попкорн: corn that pops when you heat it, a snack for the cinema
сир: a yellow or white food made from milk
шоколад: a sweet brown food made from cocoa
Гра «Yummy or yucky?»: називай слово анг: Play «Yummy or yucky?»: say a word in English, the child repeats it and shows with a gesture whether they like that food. Then play «Magic bag»: «take» imaginary food out of a bag, and the child guesses from your movements (peeling a banana, eating soup with a spoon).
Food or drink? Sort into groups.
Подивись пісню. Які страви тобі здалися: Watch the song. Which dishes did you think were the funniest?
У пісні звичайні страви змішуються в див: In the song, ordinary dishes are mixed into strange pairs (broccoli + ice cream). First viewing: the child just watches and shows the «yummy» or «yucky» gesture after each pair. Second viewing: sing the answers Yes, I do / No, I don’t together, then do the exercises.
Питаємо: **Do you like pizza?**\n\nВідпо:
We ask: **Do you like pizza?**

We answer: **Yes, I do!** or **No, I don’t.**

The short answer repeats **do**, not like.

About yourself: **I like** bananas. **I don’t like** soup.
Пограйте в «пінг-понг питаннями»: ти пит: Play «question ping-pong»: you ask Do you like…?, the child answers and immediately asks you. Make sure the child doesn’t say Yes, I like or No, I not. If there’s a mistake, repeat the correct answer with the rhythm from the song.
Гра «Food survey»: дитина питає тебе (і,: Play «Food survey»: the child asks you (and, if possible, someone at home) about 5 dishes and marks a plus or a minus in a table. Then the child reports: My teacher likes cheese. Then the opinion scale and a voice answer. For movement: «yummy» means jump up, «yucky» means squat down.
Придумай чудернацьке меню з 3 страв і на: Make up a crazy menu with 3 dishes and write whether you like them.
Exit task: назви 3 речі, які ти любиш, і: Exit task: name 3 things you like and 2 things you don’t like. Homework: draw a «crazy menu» for a café with 4 strange dishes (for example, banana soup) and label them yummy or yucky. You can sing the song again with your parents.
Назвемо погоду і одяг\nПрочитаємо листів:
Name the weather and clothes
Read a postcard from a friend
Learn to say It’s sunny and I’m wearing a jacket
Decide what to wear in different weather and write a reply
Попроси дитину подивитися у вікно і опис: Ask the child to look out of the window and describe the weather in one word. Play «Weather moves»: sunny (arms up like the sun), rainy (fingers «dripping»), windy (sway from side to side), snowy (shiver with cold). You say the word, the child acts it out.
вітряно: when there is a lot of wind
хмарно: when there are lots of clouds in the sky
холодно: with a low temperature, not warm
чоботи: strong shoes that cover your feet and legs
шарф: a long piece of cloth you wear around your neck
шапка, капелюх: something you wear on your head
парасолька: a thing you hold over your head when it rains
Гра «Dress the teacher»: дитина каже, що: Play «Dress the teacher»: the child tells you what to put on (Put on a scarf!), and you «put on» imaginary clothes. Then swap. After the game, do the exercises. Pay attention to an umbrella (an before a vowel sound).
Weather or clothes? Sort into groups.
Перед читанням спитай: Where is Mia? Wha: Before reading, ask: Where is Mia? What do you think? The child reads the postcard alone, then answers the gist question. Second reading with a pencil: underline all the words about weather and clothes. Then do the detail exercises. Explain unknown words (bobble, skiing) with gestures.
Погода: **It’s** + слово: It’s sunny. It:
Weather: **It’s** + word: It’s sunny. It’s cold. We ask: **What’s the weather like?**

Clothes you have on **now**: **I’m wearing** a jacket. **She’s wearing** boots. **They’re wearing** hats.

This is the Present Continuous: am / is / are + verb with **-ing**.
Гра «Fashion show»: дитина «виходить на: Play «Fashion show»: the child «walks the catwalk» and describes their clothes: I’m wearing a T-shirt and jeans. Then the child describes you: You’re wearing… A common mistake: I wearing (without am). Correct it by pointing to yourself: I AM wearing.
Рольова гра «Weather reporter»: дитина в: Role-play «Weather reporter»: the child presents the weather forecast for different cities (Lviv: It’s rainy. Wear boots and take an umbrella!), and you are a viewer asking What should I wear? You can hold a «microphone» (a pen). Then a voice recording.
Write a reply to Mia (3-4 sentences).
Нагадай структуру листа: привітання, 2-3: Remind the child of the letter structure: greeting, 2-3 sentences, signature (Love, …). Homework: keep a «weather diary» for a week with a drawing and a sentence every day: Monday: It’s cloudy. I’m wearing a jacket.
Назвемо членів сім’ї\nПослухаємо, як Мак:
Name family members
Listen to Max showing his friend a photo of his family
Learn to say have got / has got
Talk and write about your family
Попроси дитину заздалегідь підготувати ф: Ask the child to prepare a family photo or a drawing of their family in advance. If there’s no photo, draw simple figures together. At this stage, the child can name people in their own language.
сестра: a girl who has the same parents as you
брат: a boy who has the same parents as you
двоюрідний брат / сестра: the child of your aunt or uncle
домашній улюбленець: an animal you keep at home
Пісенька на пальцях «Finger family»: вел: Finger song «Finger family»: the thumb is dad, the index finger is mum, the middle finger is brother, the ring finger is sister, the little finger is baby. The child shows the fingers and names them. Then do the exercises. Explain that cousin is used for both boys and girls.
Who is it? Write the word.
Перед слуханням: Max shows his family ph: Before listening: Max shows his family photo. Who can you see? The first listening is for general understanding, the second for details. While listening, the child raises a hand on hearing a family word. You can read the dialogue in roles after the exercises.
Grammar: have got / has got · 10 хв: Grammar: have got / has got · 10 min
I / you / we / they **have got**, але he:
I / you / we / they **have got**, but he / she / it **has got**.

I **have got** a sister. She **has got** a cat.

Question: **Have** you **got** a brother? Yes, I **have**. / No, I **haven’t**.

**Has** she **got** a pet? Yes, she **has**. / No, she **hasn’t**.
Гра «Family cards»: на картках різні чле: Play «Family cards»: the cards show different family members and animals. The child draws a card and says: I have got a… Then about you: You have got… And about a doll or toy: She has got… A common mistake: She have got. Correct it by drawing an «s» in the air.
Fill in have got or has got.
Дитина показує фото чи малюнок і презент: The child shows a photo or drawing and presents the family: This is my… She has got… You ask follow-up questions. Then swap: you describe an imaginary family, and the child draws what they hear. At the end, a voice recording.
Напиши про свою сім’ю (4-5 речень), як М: Write about your family (4-5 sentences), like Max.
Exit task: назви 5 членів сім’ї за 20 се: Exit task: name 5 family members in 20 seconds. Homework: draw a family tree and label everyone: This is my grandma. She has got a garden.
Подивимось коротку серію мультика англій:
Watch a short cartoon episode in English
Learn words about rain and weather
Learn to say what we love doing: I love jumping
Talk about what we do on a rainy day and on a sunny day
Почни з руху: «It’s raining!» (пальці «к: Start with movement: «It’s raining!» (fingers «drip» from top to bottom), «Jump!» (a jump), «Splash!» (stamp your foot). The child repeats. Then ask the questions from the block; one-word answers are fine for A1.
дощ: water that falls from the clouds
калюжа: a small pool of water on the ground
дощовик: a coat that keeps you dry in the rain
сміятися: to make happy sounds when something is funny
хлюпати, бризкати: to hit water so that it flies around
Розклади на підлозі «калюжі» з паперу. Т: Put paper «puddles» on the floor. You say a word, the child jumps into a puddle and repeats it. Show gestures for boots, raincoat, umbrella. Then do the exercises.
Подивись серію (5 хв). Порахуй, скільки: Watch the episode (5 min). Count how many times the characters jump into a puddle!
Перед переглядом покажи жестами: rain, j: Before watching, show with gestures: rain, jump, boots. First viewing: the child counts the jumps and jumps along with the characters. Second viewing with pauses: What is the weather like? What is Peppa doing? Children answer in one word, which is fine for A1.
Щоб сказати, що ти любиш робити, додай *:
To say what you love doing, add **-ing** to the verb: **I love jumping. I love swimming. I love playing.**

Remember: swim = swi**mm**ing, run = ru**nn**ing, dance = danc**ing** (no e).
Гра «I love…»: дитина показує дію, ти вг: Play «I love…»: the child acts out an action and you guess: You love dancing! Then swap. If the child says I love jump, repeat it, stressing the ending: jump-ING! You can clap your hands on -ing.
Rainy day or sunny day? Що ти робиш? Роз: Rainy day or sunny day? What do you do? Sort.
Рольова гра «Peppa and Mummy Pig»: дитин: Role-play «Peppa and Mummy Pig»: the child is Peppa, you are Mummy. Peppa: Can I jump in puddles? Mummy: Yes, but put on your boots! Then swap. If there’s energy left, jump into the paper puddles at every I love jumping! At the end, a voice recording.
Write 3 sentences about what you love doing.
Exit task: дитина називає 3 слова про до: Exit task: the child names 3 words about rain and one sentence with I love…ing. Homework: draw yourself on a rainy day (boots, raincoat, umbrella) and write: It’s raining. I love jumping in puddles! You can watch the episode again with your parents.
